themes.name: community
themes.title: Valkey community
themes.desc: An abstract constellation of connected nodes, the best-connected of them drawn as the white Valkey hexagon mark, representing the Valkey community. The title "Valkey community" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Constellation graph, best-connected peers drawn as the Valkey mark
themes.useFor: Community highlights, contributor spotlights, roundups, governance
themes.caption: Community

themes.name: performance
themes.title: Valkey performance
themes.desc: Abstract streaks of light converging on the white Valkey hexagon mark at a bright vanishing point, representing throughput and low latency. The title "Valkey performance" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Command traffic warping into the mark at a vanishing point
themes.useFor: Throughput, latency, speed work
themes.caption: Performance

themes.name: memory-efficiency
themes.title: Valkey memory efficiency
themes.desc: An abstract grid of cells that grows denser from left to right, representing the same data stored in less memory. The title "Valkey memory efficiency" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Cell grid, pitted on the left, compacted dense on the right
themes.useFor: Memory footprint, encodings, defragmentation
themes.caption: Memory efficiency

themes.name: clustering
themes.title: Valkey clustering and scale
themes.desc: An abstract ring of slot segments around a meshed core centred on the white Valkey hexagon mark, with shards joining from outside, representing cluster mode and horizontal scale. The title "Valkey clustering and scale" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Slot ring around a meshed core, shards joining from outside
themes.useFor: Cluster mode, replication, scaling out
themes.caption: Clustering and scale

themes.name: release
themes.title: Valkey release
themes.desc: Valkey chevrons driving into a golden burst centred on the white Valkey hexagon mark, representing a new Valkey release. The title "Valkey release" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Valkey chevrons driving into a golden burst
themes.useFor: Release and general announcements
themes.caption: Release

themes.name: release-version
themes.title: Valkey release with a caption
themes.desc: A golden burst centred on the white Valkey hexagon mark above a large caption, representing a specific Valkey release.
themes.motif: The same burst with a caption you set
themes.useFor: A specific release. See [Captions](#captions)

themes.name: atomic-slot-migration
themes.title: Valkey atomic slot migration
themes.desc: Two shard slot rings, each centred on the white Valkey hexagon mark, with a chevron arrow driving a stream of slot segments from one to the other and a magnifier inspecting them mid-flight, representing atomic slot migration. The title "Valkey atomic slot migration" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Two shard rings, a chevron driving slots between them, magnifier on the stream
themes.useFor: Slot migration and rebalancing
themes.caption: Atomic slot migration

themes.name: atomic-slot-migration-quiet
themes.title: Valkey atomic slot migration
themes.desc: Two shard slot rings each centred on the white Valkey hexagon mark, the left one showing four contiguous slots vacated in dashed purple and the right one the same four arrived in solid green, a quiet stream of slot segments running between them, a green chevron driving that stream into the destination, and a large magnifier over the middle of the stream resolving the band into separate slots, representing watching one contiguous range migrate atomically. The title "Valkey atomic slot migration" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: The same two rings and lens, with the lens given the frame
themes.useFor: Slot migration when the point is watching it happen
themes.caption: Atomic slot migration

themes.name: slot-migration-lens
themes.title: Valkey slot migration under inspection
themes.desc: Two Valkey instances drawn as quiet rings around the white hexagon mark with a thin stream running between them, and a large teal magnifying glass over the middle of that stream showing the objects in transit as bars of different lengths and colours, on a flat purple field, representing observability for slot migration. The title "Valkey slot migration under inspection" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: A big lens over the migration stream, instances and stream quiet
themes.useFor: Observability for migration, inspecting data in transit
themes.caption: Slot migration under inspection

themes.name: security-shield-clean
themes.title: Valkey security
themes.desc: A shield woven from a single even lattice with the white Valkey hexagon mark at its centre and nothing else inside it, representing security and hardening. The title "Valkey security" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: A radiant shield woven from one even lattice, the mark at its centre
themes.useFor: Security in general, CVEs, hardening, ACLs, advisories
themes.caption: Security

themes.name: benchmarks
themes.title: Valkey benchmarks
themes.desc: A bar chart of throughput climbing left to right, beneath two flat latency series labelled P99 in green and P50 in red, representing benchmarking and observability.
themes.motif: Throughput bars climbing under flat P50/P99 latency
themes.useFor: Benchmark results, observability, metrics

themes.name: data-structures
themes.title: Valkey data structures
themes.desc: Abstract hash table buckets chaining outward beside a skip list of express lanes, representing Valkey data structures and internals. The title "Valkey data structures" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Hash buckets chaining out beside a skip list
themes.useFor: Internals: hash tables, skip lists, new types, modules
themes.caption: Data structures

themes.name: how-to
themes.title: Valkey how-to
themes.desc: An abstract track of numbered steps with the current step lit, representing a step-by-step guide. The title "Valkey how-to" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Step track with the current step lit
themes.useFor: Tutorials, guides, getting started
themes.caption: How-to

themes.name: keyspace-scan
themes.title: Valkey keyspace scan
themes.desc: A wide field of keys with one bounded window lit in green, the keys behind it dimmed and the keys ahead of it unlit, above a track of uneven cursor steps, representing scanning a keyspace a window at a time instead of reading it all at once. The title "Valkey keyspace scan" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Cursor holding one lit window of a key field, uneven hop track below
themes.useFor: `SCAN`, cursors, iterating a keyspace without blocking
themes.caption: Keyspace scan

themes.name: large-key
themes.title: Valkey large key
themes.desc: An even field of small identical key tiles with one key of the same shape scaled up until it dwarfs them all, outlined in red, representing a single key far larger than everything else in the keyspace. The title "Valkey large key" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: A field of identical key tiles with one scaled up until it dwarfs them
themes.useFor: Large keys, hot keys, uneven key sizes
themes.caption: Large key

themes.name: key-prefix-groups
themes.title: Valkey key prefix groups
themes.desc: A scattered cloud of sampled keys on the left funnelling into a short list of prefix rows with count bars on the right, representing a sample of key names grouped into browsable prefixes. The title "Valkey key prefix groups" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Sampled keys funnelling into prefix rows with count bars
themes.useFor: Key naming, prefixes, keyspace browsing and clients
themes.caption: Key prefix groups

themes.name: bloom-bit-array
themes.title: Valkey Bloom filters
themes.desc: The white Valkey hexagon mark above a long row of bit cells, with five hash nodes fanning out of it and the five cells they land on lit in green, representing one item hashed to a handful of positions in a Bloom filter. The title "Valkey Bloom filters" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Hash nodes fanning out of the mark, lighting a handful of cells in a bit array
themes.useFor: Bloom filters, valkey-bloom, probabilistic data structures
themes.caption: Bloom filters

themes.name: search-vector-nearest
themes.title: Valkey vector search
themes.desc: A dark field of indexed vectors with the white Valkey hexagon mark at the centre as the query, spokes reaching out to six bright green nearest matches inside a dashed search radius, representing vector similarity search. The title "Valkey vector search" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Query at the centre of an indexed field, its nearest matches lit inside a search radius
themes.useFor: Vector similarity search, KNN queries, embeddings
themes.caption: Vector search

themes.name: search-field-index
themes.title: Valkey secondary indexing
themes.desc: Four record cards each contributing one highlighted green field to a sorted index lane below, with a query caliper bracketing three matched entries above the white Valkey hexagon mark, representing secondary indexing on hashes and JSON. The title "Valkey secondary indexing" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Records giving up one field each to a sorted index, a query bracketing the matched run
themes.useFor: Secondary indexing on hashes and JSON, FT.CREATE, filters
themes.caption: Secondary indexing

themes.name: client-ports
themes.title: Valkey client protocol
themes.desc: Six differently drawn channels reaching in from distinct outer shapes, each meeting an identical port at the same radius, beyond which every spoke becomes the same run of pale segments arriving at the white Valkey hexagon mark, representing different client libraries meeting one protocol at one server. The title "Valkey client protocol" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Six unlike callers docking into identical ports around the mark, uniform inside the port circle
themes.useFor: A specific client release, client API design
themes.caption: Client protocol

themes.name: ai-agent-memory
themes.title: Valkey AI agent memory
themes.desc: A row of conversation turns with the most recent ones lit inside a bright window, older turns dimmed and parked in an archive below the white Valkey hexagon mark, and two of them arcing back up into the window, representing agent memory with hot recent context and older context recalled on demand. The title "Valkey AI agent memory" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Conversation turns on a tape, recent ones lit in a window, older ones archived below and arcing back
themes.useFor: Agent memory, chat history, context windows, mem0
themes.caption: AI agent memory

themes.name: workload-fanout
themes.title: Valkey workload primitives
themes.desc: The white Valkey hexagon mark fanning out into five lanes, each ending in a differently shaped structure: a ring of slots, a chain of entries, a ranked stack, a grid of bits and a row of embedding magnitudes, representing a workload decomposing into the primitives Valkey already has. The title "Valkey workload primitives" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: One inbound stream splitting at the mark into five differently shaped structures
themes.useFor: AI workloads mapped onto Valkey primitives
themes.caption: Workload primitives

themes.name: conn-storm-spike
themes.title: Valkey connection storms
themes.desc: A timeline of connection attempts that is quiet, then spikes into a wall of simultaneous reconnects whose top rises in red above a dashed accept-capacity line, then falls quiet again, representing a connection storm. The title "Valkey connection storms" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Flat run of connection attempts spiking into a wall that overshoots the accept ceiling
themes.useFor: Connection storms, accept backlog, reconnect surges
themes.caption: Connection storms

themes.name: bundle-crate
themes.title: Valkey bundle
themes.desc: One bracketed package outline sealed with the white Valkey hexagon mark, holding four module diagrams inside it: a bit array, a nested document in brackets, a magnifier over a scatter of points, and a padlock, representing the four modules valkey-bundle ships as one package. The title "Valkey bundle" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: One bracketed package sealed with the mark, holding the bundle's four modules: bit array, nested document, magnifier, padlock
themes.useFor: valkey-bundle, module distributions, batteries-included packaging
themes.caption: Bundle

themes.name: bundle-one-install
themes.title: Valkey bundle, one install
themes.desc: A port marked with the white Valkey hexagon fanning out into four module diagrams: a nested document in brackets, a bit array, a magnifier over a scatter of points, and a padlock, representing one install that delivers all four bundled modules. The title "Valkey bundle, one install" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: A single strap arriving at the mark and branching into the same four modules
themes.useFor: valkey-bundle, one install that delivers several capabilities
themes.caption: Bundle, one install

themes.name: tooling-stack
themes.title: Valkey primitives and tools

The title "Valkey primitives and tools" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Identical primitives at the base, differently detailed tools resting on them, the mark on top
themes.useFor: Server primitives, what gets built on them, extensibility

themes.name: data-structures-grid
themes.title: Valkey data types

The title "Valkey data types" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Six value types, one per cell on an even 3x2 grid: byte run, list, set, hash, sorted set, bitmap

themes.caption: Data types

themes.name: key-size-distribution
themes.title: Valkey key size distribution
themes.desc: A Valkey Admin panel ranking keys by size with each size printed beside its bar, the top two at tens of megabytes and drawn in red, wired along a trunk into three shard enclosures of three servers each drawn as the white Valkey hexagon mark, representing a few outsized objects spread across a deployment. The title "Valkey key size distribution" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.

themes.name: blackhole-gargantua
themes.title: Valkey black hole
themes.desc: A black hole seen almost edge on: a black circular shadow wrapped by one thin bright ring that closes all the way round it, the accretion disk lensed over the top and its secondary image returning underneath, the flat disk running out to both edges of the frame as a warm band, even in brightness on both sides, with the white Valkey hexagon mark at the centre. The title "Valkey black hole" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: Edge-on relativistic disk, one thin ring closing right round the shadow, even on both sides

themes.caption: Black hole

themes.name: blackhole-halo
themes.title: Valkey black hole
themes.desc: A black hole seen at a slight tilt so the lensed ring around its shadow opens into a broad halo, white at the inner edge through gold to red at the rim, even in brightness on both sides, with the white Valkey hexagon mark at the centre. The title "Valkey black hole" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: The same model tilted, the ring opened into a broad white-to-red halo
themes.useFor: Same
themes.caption: Black hole

themes.name: blackhole-beamed
themes.title: Valkey black hole
themes.desc: A relativistic accretion disk seen almost edge on: a dark circular shadow ringed by a thin bright photon ring, the disk lensed up over the top of the shadow and crossing in front of it below, blazing white on the left where the orbiting gas comes towards the viewer and fading to dim red on the right where it recedes, the white Valkey hexagon mark at the centre. The title "Valkey black hole" is set on solid light blocks in the lower left.
themes.motif: The same model with Doppler beaming left in, so one side blazes
themes.useFor: Same, when the physics is the point
themes.caption: Black hole
